newsitem.title: UK: Cash machine plot "threatened British bank system".
newsitem.headline: Cash machine plot "threatened British bank system".

text.p: Seven men pleaded guilty on Monday to an attempt to steal money from cash dispensers in a plot that prosecutors claimed could have destabilised the whole British banking system.
Southwark Crown Court in London heard that the men intended to tap into the lines running between cash dispensers and computers at banks and other financial institutions.
With the information obtained they intended to make bogus cards to steal cash from the machines.

"Had the conspiracy succeeded, the banking system of this country would have been put at risk," prosecutor Ann Curnow said. However, the plot was foiled by a police informant and no money was stolen. Sentence on the seven was deferred to December.
